stem: An aqueous solution of cobalt(II) chloride is a pink colour due to the presence of $[\text{Co}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ complex ions.

parts.text:

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Give the units of the stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$, of the $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$ complex ion.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
The numerical value of the stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$, of the $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$ complex ion is $7.7 \times 10^4$.

In an aqueous solution the concentration of the $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$ complex ion is $0.0740\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ and the concentration of $\text{NH}_3$ is $0.480\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ at equilibrium.

Calculate the concentration of $[\text{Co}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ in this solution.
